invariants_covered: population identity: row digest sealed per cell; mismatch rejected (campaign, comparators, elastic net, predictive)
fold/target/K/seed identity: plan digest binds folds, sealed Ks, seed, membership and every method setting; chunked and full runs share one digest

VALIDATION/TEST rejection: input_label != TRAIN rejected in every selector; rows at or after 2024-01-01 refused by the loader; folds validating outside TRAIN refused; file names naming validation/test/holdout/2024/2025 refused
complete-ranking invariant: every method returns all groups exactly once; a sensitivity K above the group count is retained per K without erasing the ranking
RANDOM_K reproducibility: seed 0 replays bitwise; a different seed differs; permutation equals numpy default_rng(seed)
group gate: membership must name every group; signal clusters pass the temporal null, noise clusters do not (4000-row fixture, 5 shifts, mean+3sd rule)
refit-after-removal: same model recipe recorded; a refit with nothing removed reproduces the baseline MAE and importances exactly; a different seed differs
temporal block permutation: blocks stay contiguous and in order, shared across features, seeded
causal imputation: later rows never change earlier imputed values; leading gaps take the fit-row mean
denominator reconciliation: 46+298+22 per batch and total enforced; selector-episode sources and quality-excluded columns counted separately
resume: only records with identical identity and COMPLETE disposition are skipped
progress: done/total at method x target x fold x K, failures retained, ETA from observed median wall
